title: The run step reruns precheck after the research story lands, and plan words a clause no stronger than its check
goal: The run section of skills/sprint/SKILL.md says to rerun backlog.py precheck SP after the goal research story lands and to tighten each sibling check that now passes before its claim while the plan section says a goal clause is worded no stronger than its check

run: import sys;t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();s=t.split('## run [SP]',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0];p=t.split('## plan',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0];a=any('precheck' in l and 'research' in l and 'tighten' in l for l in s.splitlines());b='no stronger than its check' in p;print('run step reruns precheck after the research story and tightens:',a,'plan words a clause no stronger than its check:',b);sys.exit(0 if a and b else 1)
